decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree is close to the core yogurt business and has proven appeal with consumers, so keeping it is low-risk.
The Abendbrotkäse is presented on the home page as a flagship of the new cheese direction, so the firm is likely to keep supporting it in its first full year.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a basic, close-to-core item that fits the organic cheese range and is unlikely to be withdrawn this quickly.
The spicy cheese line may see individual variants trimmed, but the line as a whole is likely kept while the cheese range is being built up.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the new 2018 range and is mainstream enough to keep for now.
The washed-rind soft cheese is more niche and has a higher delisting risk with retailers, but it will probably get more time on the market.
